camps.name: Adventure Camp (Summer Camp)
camps.description_short: A state-licensed full-day summer camp in Nashua for children entering grades 1 through 7. Activities include swimming, field trips, trips to NH state parks, sports, arts and crafts, and STEM. The Learning Center also runs vacation camps during the February and April school breaks.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Campers walk to Crown Hill Pool on Mondays and Wednesdays, where trained lifeguards are on duty along with camp staff. Children must pass a swim test (swim the length of the pool and tread water for one minute) to go past belly-button depth; retests are each Monday. Lake days at Pawtuckaway State Park are lifeguarded by the State Park.

camps.name: Ascend at Camp Monadnock
camps.description_short: A Christian overnight summer camp week in Jaffrey, NH. There are separate weeks for kids (finishing grades 2-5) and teens (finishing grades 6-12). Campers stay in dorms from Sunday to Thursday and do outdoor activities, worship, Bible teaching and small groups.

camps.name: Camp Lawrence
camps.description_short: Overnight YMCA camp for boys ages 8-16 on Bear Island in Lake Winnipesaukee, NH, with two-week sessions (one-week sessions only for first-time junior campers). Boys choose their own schedule from sports, waterfront, arts and outdoor-skills activities.

Full balance is due April 1, 2027, with a $150 late fee after that. camps.name: Camp Naticook
camps.description_short: A town-run traditional day camp at Wasserman Park on Naticook Lake in Merrimack, NH, for children entering Kindergarten through 5th grade. Campers do sports, games, arts and crafts, nature activities, swimming, boating, archery and theater, and a daily hot lunch is included.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Each session requires a $50 non-refundable deposit, and the full balance is due 45 days before the session starts. If you cancel at least 30 days ahead, you lose only the deposit. Cancelling 15–30 days ahead gets a 50% refund of what you paid, minus the deposit, and there are no refunds within 15 days of the start. Transfers to another session have no penalty if made at least 30 days ahead. Medical cancellations within 14 days of the start need a doctor's letter and get a 50% refund of the remaining amount, minus the deposit.
camps.special_needs_notes: The camp no longer provides one-to-one aides. Campers must be able to take part in their assigned group and tell staff what they need. Families are encouraged to call the camp to discuss fit. For one-to-one support, the camp suggests Camp Allen (Bedford), Recreational Education Center (Londonderry) or Camp Starfish (Rindge).
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on Naticook Lake. Campers go on canoe trips and have free swim time at the waterfront and beach. American Red Cross swim lessons are offered at no extra cost (the page's text says 'Returning for 2025').

camps.name: Camp Starfish
camps.description_short: An overnight camp on Lake Monomonac in Rindge, NH for children ages 6 to 17 with emotional, behavioral and learning challenges. Its core programs (two-week Navigators and OCP sessions, five-day Lite and Havvago) have one staff member for every camper; shorter specialty weeks serve siblings and teens.
camps.special_needs_notes: Serves children with emotional, behavioral and learning challenges. Core programs keep one staff member for every camper, but no child is assigned a single dedicated adult. A nurse lives on site; there is no doctor on site. Campers should feed themselves, use the toilet on their own, and be able to get around hilly ground. Not suitable for children with feeding tubes, IV medications or daily injections, or with frequent violent behavior. Accessibility is still being improved, so families of campers with mobility limits should call before applying. Vegetarian meals are available; gluten-free is partly available; kosher is not.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: More than 1/2 mile of shoreline on Lake Monomonac, with access from several private beaches.

camps.special_needs_notes: Nut-safe kitchen with no nut products or oils; vegetarian options at every meal, and gluten-free and kosher-style menus can be accommodated.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Waterfront on Lake Wentworth (state Class A water, sandy bottom, little boat traffic) with nearly half a mile of private sandy beach. Campers can join swim meets and sailing regattas.

camps.name: Water Monkey Camp
camps.description_short: Overnight watersports camp on Merrymeeting Lake in New Durham, NH, focused on wakeboarding, waterskiing, wakesurfing and wake skating. Each Sunday-to-Friday week takes at most 9 boys and girls ages 9-17, who live in lakeside cabins with their counselors.
camps.refund_policy_summary: The $1,750-per-week tuition deposit is fully refundable until April 1. After that date, no refunds are given for any reason.
camps.special_needs_notes: Food allergies and dietary needs can be fully accommodated if the camp is told in advance. The chef cooks all meals from scratch.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on the shore of Merrymeeting Lake and has a sandy beach. All staff must be certified lifeguards. There is at least 1 counselor for every 3 campers, and no more than 9 campers per week. Boat lessons continue in rain unless there is thunder or lightning. The camp provides all watersports and safety equipment and uses a Supra SV450 boat in 2027.

camps.name: Windsor Mountain International Summer Camp
camps.description_short: A non-competitive, co-ed overnight camp for ages 7-16 on a 365-acre lakefront site in Windsor, New Hampshire, with campers from the US and abroad. Campers pick their own activities, and sessions run 2, 3.5, 6 or 7 weeks.

camps.name: YMCA Camp Mi-Te-Na
camps.description_short: A Granite YMCA overnight camp for boys ages 8 to 15 in Alton, NH, with campfires, specialty activities, trips and socials with sister Camp Foss. Stays run one week, two weeks, one month or the full summer, June 27 to August 21, 2027.
camps.refund_policy_summary: For a non-medical, non-emergency cancellation, you must contact the Enrollment Coordinator at least four weeks before the session starts. Deposits taken at registration are non-refundable. A medical cancellation needs a doctor's note saying the camper cannot take part. Final payment is due May 15, 2027.

camps.name: McAuliffe-Shepard Discovery Center STEM Summer Camps
camps.description_short: Weekly STEM day camps at a science center and planetarium in Concord, NH. Each week has a theme (coding, astronomy, dinosaurs, rockets, astronauts, earth science) aimed at a specific age group.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Full refund if you cancel at least 30 days before the session starts. No refund if you cancel less than 30 days before, except for a documented emergency. Cancellations must be sent by email.

camps.name: WildQuest Day Camps
camps.description_short: A nature day camp at Prescott Farm in Laconia, NH, running nine themed summer weeks for ages 5 to 14, 9am to 4pm, plus February and April vacation weeks. Campers spend most of the day outdoors with nature activities, animal and plant identification, arts and crafts, cooking, games and hands-on learning.
camps.refund_policy_summary: A $100 non-refundable deposit per session, per child, holds each spot. Cancel more than four weeks before the session for a refund of everything else paid; within four weeks, refunds only if the spot is filled. No refunds for no-shows, missed days or weather.

camps.name: YMCA Camp Sargent
camps.description_short: A traditional YMCA day camp on Lake Naticook in Merrimack, NH. It offers a general Summer Fun day camp for grades K-8, weekly morning specialty camps for grades K-9, and a Leaders in Training program for grades 9-12.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: The camp is on Lake Naticook. Swimming and boating are part of the daily program, and a Boating Camp for grades 5-9 teaches kayaking, canoeing, paddleboarding, water safety and life jacket use.
